newsitem.title: USA: USF&G to expand buyback plan to 11 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: USF&G to expand buyback plan to 11 mln shrs.

text.p: USF&G Corp said on Wednesday its board of directors agreed to expand its previously announced common stock repurchase plan to a maximum of 11 million shares from a maximum of 5.0 million shares.
It said it had already bought 3.6 million shares since it began the repurchase program in April.

USF&G said the board had also authorized the repurchase of the remaining shares of its $10.25 Series B cumulative convertible preferred stock or its common stock equivalent, which would total 2.3 million shares.
USF&G is a property and casualty insurer, with United States Fidelity and Guaranty Co as its main subsidiaries.
